plan: The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid 50% of your value. While other bidders may deviate, consistently following this strategy maximizes long-term profit. My value is $10, so 50% is $5. I will bid $5. This minimizes the risk of overpaying and maximizes the chance of winning when my value is relatively high, while limiting losses when my value is low.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid 50% of my value. This is because my profit is (Value - Second Highest Bid) if I win, and 0 if I lose. Bidding 50% ensures I win when my value is higher than others' and avoids overpaying. Given my value is $30, 50% is $15. I will stick to this strategy for this single round.
